items.title: ContextCov: Deriving and Enforcing Executable Constraints from Agent Instruction Files
items.title_zh: ContextCov：从智能体指令文件推导并执行可执行约束
items.summary: ContextCov turns passive natural-language agent instruction files such as AGENTS.md into executable guardrails, compiling documented constraints into static AST queries, runtime shell shims and architectural validators that intercept agent actions with reproducible violation traces. On SWE-bench Lite across 12 repositories and 300 tasks it reaches 88.3% constraint compliance versus 67.0% for prompt-only and 50.3% for reflection baselines, at 3.4x lower feedback cost while maintaining functional correctness.

items.title: Draft-Thinking: Learning Efficient Reasoning in Long Chain-of-Thought LLMs
items.title_zh: Draft-Thinking：在长思维链大模型中学习高效推理
items.summary: Draft-Thinking learns a model-adapted draft chain of thought through progressive supervised fine-tuning and two-stage reinforcement learning, avoiding post-hoc trajectory compression or an explicit length penalty. With 847 training problems and 120 RL optimization steps, its draft mode cuts MATH500 average response length from 5,668 to 986 tokens (82.6%) while reaching 90.6% accuracy versus 93.0% for the original long-CoT model.

items.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of LLM Unlearning Robustness under Multi-Turn Interaction
items.title_zh: 多轮交互下 LLM 遗忘鲁棒性的综合评估
items.summary: The paper examines whether LLM unlearning remains stable in interactive settings through self-correction and dialogue-conditioned querying, and finds that knowledge appearing forgotten in static evaluation can often be recovered through interaction. Stronger unlearning improves apparent robustness but often produces behavioral rigidity rather than genuine knowledge erasure, suggesting static evaluation may overestimate real-world effectiveness.

items.title: IDER: IDempotent Experience Replay for Reliable Continual Learning
items.title_zh: IDER：面向可靠持续学习的幂等经验回放
items.summary: IDER introduces idempotent experience replay for continual learning, adapting the training loss so the model is idempotent on current data streams and adding an idempotence distillation loss that feeds current model outputs back through an old checkpoint. The authors report improved prediction reliability, higher accuracy and reduced forgetting across continual-learning benchmarks, with code released.

items.title: TopoEdge: Topology-Grounded Agentic Framework for Edge Networking Code Generation and Repair
items.title_zh: TopoEdge：面向边缘网络代码生成与修复的拓扑锚定智能体框架
items.summary: TopoEdge represents each target network topology as a router-level graph embedded by a contrastively trained GNN, retrieves a verified reference configuration and driver, and assembles them into a topology-grounded RAG context. Planning, generation and verification agents then run an execution-centric generate-verify-repair loop over an FRRouting Topotest/pytest harness.

items.title: BLUFF: Benchmarking the Detection of False and Synthetic Content across 58 Low-Resource Languages
items.title_zh: BLUFF：跨 58 种低资源语言的虚假与合成内容检测基准
items.summary: BLUFF is a benchmark for detecting false and synthetic content spanning 79 languages and over 202,000 samples, covering human-written, LLM-generated, LLM-translated and hybrid text with 39 textual modification techniques. Experiments show state-of-the-art detectors suffer up to 25.3% F1 degradation on low-resource versus high-resource languages, and the dataset and code are released.

items.title: Constitutional Black-Box Monitoring for Scheming in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体阴谋行为的宪法式黑盒监控
items.summary: The authors study constitutional black-box monitors, prompted classifiers that detect scheming in LLM agents from externally observable inputs and outputs, optimized on synthetic trajectories from two generation pipelines. Monitors selected purely on synthetic data generalize to 7,500 held-out ControlArena trajectories, but performance saturates quickly, with simple prompt sweeps matching more extensive optimization and further pushing leading to overfitting.

items.title: NERFIFY: A Multi-Agent Framework for Turning NeRF Papers into Code
items.title_zh: NERFIFY：将 NeRF 论文转化为代码的多智能体框架
items.summary: NERFIFY is a multi-agent framework that converts NeRF research papers into trainable Nerfstudio plugins, constraining LLM code synthesis with a context-free grammar and refining artifacts through visual feedback. The authors report visual quality matching expert human code on papers without public implementations while reducing implementation time from weeks to minutes.

items.title: AgentsMesh/AgentsMesh
items.title_zh: AgentsMesh：可调度上百个 AI 编程智能体的工作平台
items.summary: AgentsMesh is a Go-based AI agent workforce platform for running a hundred AI coding agents across your own machines, with one console to schedule, isolate and steer them.
